name: PRT-based Volume Rendering Approximation
definition: A method to approximate in-scattering in volume rendering using Precomputed Radiance Transfer (PRT) and Spherical Harmonics (SH) to replace expensive double integrals with dot products and cube map lookups.
summary: PRT-based Volume Rendering Approximation uses Precomputed Radiance Transfer and Spherical Harmonics to replace expensive integrals with dot products, enabling real-time in-scattering approximation without full path tracing.
